QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_13

question.text: Under the All Citizens Model, what is the eligible age range for joining NPS?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the All Citizens Model, any Indian citizen aged 18 to 70 years can voluntarily join NPS. The Trap: The upper age limit was revised to 70 from the earlier 65. Many older references still cite 60 or 65. Note: Subscribers joining beyond age 65 are subject to special exit timing rules under the All Citizens Model, as per the workbook.
